# Analysis

- Example catalog: about 12,000 products with their description (invented for the demo).
- Starting assumption: 300 words per product, about 400 tokens per product if it is split by
  paragraph.
- The price per million tokens depends on the provider: two example price lists are compared.

## Pending validations

- Measure the real length of the descriptions on a sample of 200 products: the 300-word assumption
  has not been checked.
- Confirm how often the descriptions change (once a month?).
